recoveryAndIdempotency.status: required design; stage modules and error routes are not yet implemented in a runnable scenario
recoveryAndIdempotency.claim: Preferred Airtable-only design: sequential Make execution and PATCH performUpsert with Submission ID as the sole merge field and sole claim body field. Inspect exactly one returned record ID, compare Request Fingerprint after fetch, and stop on mismatch or an unexpectedly populated claim. A test-server SQLite primary key also rejects changed retries. This is an API-level upsert, not a database uniqueness constraint against unrelated writers; runtime behavior is untested. See JOSH_TEST_AIRTABLE_LEDGER_DRAFT.md. The Make Data store is an unused alternative.
recoveryAndIdempotency.airtableCreate: On ambiguous timeout, repeat the same performUpsert claim and fetch the one record by returned ID; never call Create record again. Multiple matching Submission IDs must stop for staff reconciliation. Force a timeout immediately after claim in an isolated probe and verify exactly one row before treating this as reliable.
recoveryAndIdempotency.externalEffects: Persist the returned order folder, Uploads folder, file-request ID/URL, optional verified team-only staff link and artwork bind result in the isolated Airtable row after each step. Dropbox create_shared_link_with_settings defaults to public when settings are omitted; do not request a default public link. If team-only is unavailable, retain a private folder path in Airtable and leave the staff URL empty. On recovery, verify existing resources match the claimed record and fixed test root before reuse; stop on a mismatch. Never autorename the order folder or silently create duplicates.
recoveryAndIdempotency.emails: Send only to Josh after the upload link has been verified. Set separate Airtable Customer/Staff Email Status to Uncertain before each send, then Sent after provider confirmation. A provider send may succeed before the status update; pause for manual Sent/inbox inspection instead of blindly resending. Exactly-once email delivery is not guaranteed by status alone.
recoveryAndIdempotency.response: Return a persisted, accurate stage. The current isolated form accepts only bound/already_bound for artwork or not_supplied without artwork, and times out after 25 seconds; test the full route against that contract or revise the isolated code before activation. A timeout must remain recoverable by Submission ID.
recoveryAndIdempotency.failures: Enable sequential execution and incomplete-execution storage, attach explicit error routes and staff-visible Airtable failure state, and force failures after performUpsert claim, folder/file request, bind and each email during controlled tests.
